function.arguments: {"observation": "There are 48 patients with multiple rows (duplicate patient_id), and each such patient has exactly two rows (sample_seq = 1 and 2). The data dictionary states that the row with the highest sample_seq supersedes earlier rows for that patient. Therefore, to get one row per patient, we must deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq.", "implication": "The population for the estimand — all unique patients — must be constructed by deduplicating on patient_id using the highest sample_seq. Failure to do so would double-count re-tested patients and bias the response rate. This affects the population and must be acted upon."}
function.name: note_finding
